acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Table apis exists with id (CUID), name (indexed), team, owner, timestamps
Table api_versions exists with api_id FK, version, environment (string), spec_json (JSONB), uploaded_at, uploaded_by, indexes on (api_id, environment) and uploaded_at

Table endpoints exists with api_version_id FK, path, method (enum), dual vector embeddings (1536 dims), metadata fields, unique constraint on (api_version_id, path, method), HNSW indexes on embeddings
Foreign key constraints with CASCADE deletes: api_versions.api_id → apis.id, endpoints.api_version_id → api_versions.id
Database migrations are versioned and reversible
HttpMethod enum with GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS
Unique constraint on endpoints (api_version_id, path, method)
HNSW indexes with m=16, ef_construction=64 for sub-second search performance

Singleton Prisma client with connection pooling, health check, metrics. Pattern to follow for exporting new model types.
Existing test patterns for database operations, pgvector operators (cosine similarity with <=>), health checks. Follow this pattern for new schema tests.
Shows migration pattern. New migrations should follow same versioned structure.

constraints.constraint: Use Prisma for schema definition and migrations - no raw SQL for model creation
Environment field MUST be string type (not enum) per ADR-009 for enterprise flexibility
Vector embeddings are 1536 dimensions for OpenAI text-embedding-3-small compatibility
Use Unsupported("vector(1536)") for pgvector columns since Prisma lacks native support
HNSW indexes require manual SQL migration (Prisma doesn't support HNSW index syntax)
Foreign keys must cascade on delete to maintain referential integrity
CUIDs for primary keys (consistent with existing ApiKey model)
All tests use Vitest framework with describe/it pattern
Database operations must use DatabaseService.getInstance() pattern

interface.name: DatabaseService
interface.signature: static getInstance(): PrismaClient; static healthCheck(): Promise<boolean>; static getMetrics(): Promise<string>

tests.standards: Vitest test framework with describe/it blocks. Integration tests for database operations use DatabaseService.getInstance() and direct Prisma queries. Test pgvector operators with $queryRaw. Located in apps/api/src/__tests__/ directory. Run with 'pnpm --filter @perrache/api test'.
